set.body:
Implement the optional projector with packaged Sanctity release inventory and authorized file reads. Freeze one accepted synthetic BIDS fixture, dictionary and count oracle. Validate exact typed joins, sessionless rows, disallowed data, unsupported suffix counts, relative paths and fixed link. Run a checksum-pinned bagel CLI in bounded staging. Persist the JSON-LD, digest and receipt before preview. Verify there are no Neurobagel dependencies in the default service distribution. Document any needed generic API fix under its owner. The fixture can use the existing routes and a hand-reviewed dictionary.

Source: docs/implementation-plan.md, External discovery through Neurobagel.
set.title: NB01: Prepare an approved Neurobagel artifact over the pinned release API
